shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a flat stone surface
radiating/petal-like forms (rosette-like palmette clusters in A; radiating rays around a central disc in B)
possible single figure/creature as a focal element
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both are low-relief carvings featuring radiating petal-like forms (A's rosette/palmette clusters, B's rays fanning from a central disc) and both may contain a small central creature or figure. Otherwise the content is quite different: A shows a specific narrative-emblematic scene of a standing winged bird-headed anthropomorphic figure with raised arm attending a stylised plant, above a band of dense script-like signs, while B shows a purely radial, non-narrative composition of straight rays converging on a raised circular boss.
